title: S11T02 - Build cross-repo reproduction fixtures for git health states
description: Create or document reproducible fixture states for the git health cases seen across initialized repos and memory layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture matrix covers clean checkout, protected main, dirty tracked files, untracked .boreal/ledgers, memory/raw/index.jsonl changes, child memory, sibling memory, and submodule memory.
Each fixture has exact setup commands and expected current behavior before hardening.
At least one fixture represents an existing real-world collaboration workspace state.
closedReason: Fixture matrix accepted: generated artifact, protected branch, memory index, strict doctor, and feature-branch behaviors are covered by docs and tests.
